text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A public training session is held for<n>the media in
preparation for the spring<n>Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text: And that concludes today's public<n>training!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide, excuse me! Could I<n>get a
one-on-one interview with you,<n>please?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I understand Narita Taishin will also<n>be at the spring
Tenno Sho. As a<n>fellow member of BNW—
choice_data_list: Everyone, please give her some room!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide's consistent<n>performance has
been earning her a<n>lot of attention. While we're
certainly<n>grateful for it...

text_block_list.name: Press
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Biwa Hayahide! Over<n>here!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She can't possibly accommodate<n>every single
interview request. We<n>politely make our way
through the<n>throng of reporters and head home.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you didn't have to be so<n>protective. They
weren't bothering<n>me.
choice_data_list: I need you to stay focused.
I need you to stay focused.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, thank you for making sure they<n>didn't distract
me. By the way, do<n>you happen to be free this
weekend?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's something important<n>happening then, and it
pertains to us<n>both.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The weekend rolls around, and it<n>doesn't take long
to figure out why<n>Biwa Hayahide wants to spend it
with<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What an absolutely gorgeous day at<n>the Nakayama
Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And here she is, the number one<n>favorite of the
Satsuki Sho, Narita<n>Brian!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Listen to those cheers... I guess this<n>is all part of the
Narita Brian package.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Ka-chak!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is in excellent position,<n>but everyone's
hot on her heels<n>coming out of the first corner.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In stark contrast to the lively<n>audience, Biwa
Hayahide watches<n>the race unfold in contemplative
silence.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
They're moving at a pretty fast clip.<n>There's only
800 meters to go! This<n>level of intensity is bound to
shake<n>some of them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The pace is fast, but the lead is just<n>barely ahead
of the pack.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This might come down to whoever<n>has enough
energy left on the<n>straightaway. I have a feeling it'll
be<n>close...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huff!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian! Narita Brian's broken<n>away from the
pack!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's in the lead! She's pulled away<n>by three
lengths—now four! She's<n>widening the gap!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And it's a total blowout! We have a<n>new record!
Narita Brian has captured<n>her first crown in
devastating fashion!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
This is incredible, folks! Narita Brian<n>has not only
won the race, she's set<n>a new record!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is now the fastest<n>Umamusume ever to
run the<n>2,000-meter at the Nakayama<n>Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
That final sprint down the stretch was<n>on a whole
other level. She may be a<n>one-in-a-million
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm going to beat her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can only speculate as to what she<n>might have said
if she had watched<n>this race prior to running in the
Kikuka<n>Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But what I do know for sure is that<n>she's starting
to sound a lot more<n>like a real fighter lately.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Bzzz, bzzz, bzzz.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? I think you're getting a call.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I take a look at my phone and raise<n>my eyebrows
at the name on the<n>screen.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see. So this year's spring Tenno<n>Sho will be held
at the Hanshin<n>Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the Kyoto Racecourse is<n>being
remodeled, so the venue for the<n>spring Tenno Sho
is being relocated to<n>the Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: But the problem is...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm, both of them are right-handed<n>courses, but the
slopes are positioned<n>differently. The area before
the finish<n>line at Kyoto is flat, but Hanshin has a
steep incline.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's no use complaining about it,<n>but this
essentially renders all of our<n>data and predictions
useless.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, all the work we've<n>done to prepare
for the spring Tenno<n>Sho goes down the drain.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well... I guess it's time to make<n>adjustments to the
winning equation<n>again.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. What's wrong? It was always<n>our plan to
prove the equation by<n>applying it practically.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's make the most of what little<n>time we have
and do the best we can.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Just like we did at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We'll have to start over from square<n>one. If we do
this, it's going to take<n>up a lot of your time too.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Biwa Hayahide who used to be<n>so lost and
indecisive is nowhere to<n>be found anymore.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Uh, Trainer? Why are you looking at<n>me like tha—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
M-my head isn't any bigger than<n>usual! See? It's
completely normal<n>sized!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
No matter what life throws at her now,<n>she's utterly
unflappable. She's truly<n>progressed so much.
